implementation.note: Sourced image/GIF deck with inline animation, neutral operative faces, generously padded private identity faces and full illustrated reveal covers. Sourced SVG meme background, softened edge color and one shared three-shade palette per team and accessible lobby. Latest direct edits were not verified at user request.

directionSelection.brief: Physical cards and original reveal tokens on a pale ground with sourced Trollface/Forever Alone/Okay Guy/Me Gusta/Yao Ming SVG linework and a full-height Blue-left/Red-right gradient. Clean UI and drag-only lobby.

brand.purpose: Header uses the supplied recolored image wordmark. Self-hosted Bricolage Grotesque 800 remains for phrases and clues.

body.purpose: Self-hosted Atkinson Hyperlegible 400/700 for readable names and controls.

motion.name: accepted-cover
motion.purpose: Downward cover settle only after acceptance; immediate under reduced motion.

focus.onTeam: Deep Blue outer outline plus Gold inset against fill

board.cardAspect: Landscape 3:2 whole cards at every viewport; source media stays contained and revealed art fills the full rounded card without resampling.
board.selection: Tap/click selects locally on all screen sizes; explicit Reveal.
board.labels: Uppercase recognition labels and text fallbacks; preserve canonical deck text and source image captions.
board.minimumWidth: 900px; horizontal board scrolling on narrower screens

lobby.permissions: Players move themselves; host moves anyone.
lobby.destinations: Red/Blue spymaster slot and operative area; shared unassigned/watch tray.
lobby.occupiedSlot: Server rejects before mutation without demotion or swap, including offline incumbents; host explicitly moves incumbent before replacement.
lobby.alternatives: No placement menu or keyboard placement, per user direction. Pointer/touch drag from anywhere on the name tag; Escape cancels an active drag.
lobby.placement: Preview until server accepts; never publish optimistic roster.
lobby.teamOrder: Blue left / Red right; stacked in that order on phones.
lobby.rounding: 10px on team areas, destinations, player pieces and placement surfaces; padded outer team areas.
lobby.identity: Team names and shared palette without identity icons. A centered six-dot grip identifies each movable name tag.
lobby.presentation: Flat outlined name tags without initials or routine Connected text. Keep You/Host/Offline only when applicable. Empty role areas need no repeated prompts; readiness reasons appear only when blocked.
lobby.randomize: Host-only button beside Start: one accepted update balances connected players and selects one spymaster per team; disconnected seats become unassigned. Start stays separate.

media.gif: Animate directly on the board; sourced local files, no inspector or posters.
media.content: Pinned reference/version; IDs and media never encode hidden identity.

coverArt.composition: Recognizable meme portraits on the supplied Codenames blue/red room, neutral fence and assassin lamplit night backgrounds. Full-bleed landscape 3:2 artwork.
coverArt.category: Dominant Red, Blue or tan across character and background; Assassin remains predominantly near-black with restrained gray/cream facial lines.
coverArt.assassin: The original classic Wojak in his black hoodie replaces the entire foreground character; retain the supplied lamplit night scenery.
coverArt.cast: Eight unique Blue and eight unique Red memes, plus the same ninth Wojak double agent in both colors; seven distinct Neutral memes and one Meme Man Assassin. Full cast and prompts in docs/assets/shipping-art.json.
coverArt.production: 26 native PNGs in public/art/covers. Each round deals unique shuffled variants, fixed in storage and projected only after reveal. Covers conceal the entire recognition strip. Previous four portrait assets removed.

wordmark.direction: User-supplied heavy italic CODEMEMES wordmark with monochrome hooded face inside O.
wordmark.adaptation: Built-in imagegen recolor toward primary Blue #0badd7 and Red #ff6247; transparent outer canvas. Larger 240-360px header logo with tightly framed image presentation.
wordmark.status: Installed in the shared entry/lobby/game header; matching favicon and touch icon installed.
wordmark.alignment: Centered above one name form: main URL creates a room, invite URL enters its room. No mode controls or manual code entry. Room header retains the larger image logo beside flat tools.

playfield.edgeLight: Full-height linear gradient: primary Blue across the left half, primary Red across the right half, 24% edge opacity and 12% near the soft neutral center.
playfield.pattern: Sourced transparent Trollface, Forever Alone, Okay Guy, Me Gusta and Yao Ming SVG linework, 82-102px faces in a repeating 960x720 tile.
playfield.controlSurface: White with dark ink and Red/Blue accents. Unguessed operative faces match neutral spymaster faces.

palette.usage: Reuse only these three shades per team across UI accents, surfaces, buttons and focus. Dark Ink on medium fills; white on dark fills. Gradient opacity uses the primary shades.

controls.presentation: Flat non-card UI: bare entry form and clue row, flat sticky action row, outlined lobby names and drag handles, text-based header tools. Preserve playable card styling.
controls.copy: No routine connection label, player footer, role explanation, Select a card prompt, discussion instruction, Round complete or Teams ready line. Preserve live announcements, labels, permission checks and actionable recovery.
controls.navigation: Leave room moves to the shared room header. Rules and game roster remain available on demand.
controls.copyFeedback: Successful copy feedback clears after 2.5 seconds; manual copy fallback remains until dismissed.

components.name: Meme face
components.description: Sourced image or autoplaying GIF with uppercase recognition label; direct selection and no inspector.

components.name: Identity cover
components.description: Distinct meme portrait on the supplied Codenames backdrop, assigned once per round without repeats within an identity; covers the full card and words after accepted reveal.

components.name: Player piece
components.description: Flat outlined name tag, draggable from any part, with a centered six-dot grip and applicable You/Host/Offline metadata. No placement menu. Preserve cancellation and accepted-state focus/announcements.

components.name: Action tray
components.description: Flat clue and action rows. Explicit Reveal/End turn or Play again when authorized; selected card named accessibly, with no repeated instructions.

narrative.overview: Physical cream meme cards and original illustrated covers on a pale off-white playfield, with soft Blue/Red edge light and sparse decorative meme faces. Clean styled UI recedes around the game.
keyCharacteristics: Draggable lobby pieces with host Randomize

rules.name: Private identity
rules.body: Never deliver an unrevealed identity to a public client, including through media metadata.

rules.name: Accepted-state feedback
rules.body: No committed cover, count or roster placement before server acceptance.

dos: Animate sourced GIFs directly on the board.
Drag any part of a name tag for manual lobby movement; the host may Randomize. Retain keyboard access to other controls.
Use sourced SVG meme faces and softened primary Red/Blue edge color on the pale playfield.
Keep controls clean, styled and readable on white/light surfaces.
donts: Do not add marketing or explanatory panels to the game.
Do not reintroduce green felt or pale on-felt labels on the light background.
